info.name: BestSeeds - End User (Farmer) App
info.description:
API collection for the BestSeeds Farmer/End-User mobile application.

Authentication: OTP-based login via mobile number → Sanctum Bearer Token.

Base URL: {{base_url}}/api/farmer

request.description: Send OTP to farmer's mobile number for login. Alias for send-otp.
Send OTP to mobile number. Validation: mobile - required|digits:10
Verify OTP and get Sanctum bearer token. Token is auto-saved to collection variable.
Resend OTP. Rate limited - returns 429 if too frequent.
Logout and revoke current Sanctum token.
Register FCM token for push notifications. device_type: android|ios
Main home screen data: banners, hatcheries, prices, updates, quick actions.
Full hatchery listing with filters and pagination.
Reason codes: 1=Delay in processing, 2=Incorrect order details, 3=Wrong quantity, 4=Stock quality issues, 5=Other (provide other_reason)

Farmer submits rating (1-5 stars) and optional message after delivery.

Rules:
- Only delivered bookings (status=5) can be rated
- One rating per booking
- Rating: 1-5 (required)
- Message: max 500 chars (optional)

Fetch vehicle tracking details for a specific booking.

Response includes:
- pickup/drop locations with lat/lng
- driver_location (current live GPS position)
- driver_details (name, phone, vehicle)
- timeline (max 100 sampled tracking entries with lat, lng, name, time, date — for drawing GPS trail polyline and showing location history)
- route_waypoints (multi-stop priority-ordered stops with lat/lng)

Timeline is sampled from vehicle_trackings table — if 1400 points exist, only ~100 evenly spaced points are returned to keep response lightweight.
